prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET for a Dreamerie spot-the-difference puzzle. Return ONE altered image with the EXACT SAME 4:5 framing, geometry, textured painted style and positions. Make exactly the five specified meaningful object edits below. Match this existing illustrator's brushwork, shading and palette. NO random new props, circular patches, tint spots, labels, arrows or answer markers. Keep absolutely everything else unchanged, including background, all edges, decorations and lighting. Do not redraw or reframe the scene. Coordinates are percentages from top-left and help identify objects, not visible boxes.
1. Edit only this object so: The giant hare closed its eye. Target near x89%, y35%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
2. Edit only this object so: The nearest large poppy turned ivory. Target near x16%, y81%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
3. Edit only this object so: The moon in the upper doorway became a crescent. Target near x48%, y14%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
4. Edit only this object so: The small diamond of paper at the upper left disappeared. Target near x12%, y3%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
5. Edit only this object so: The hare lost its lowest whisker. Target near x84%, y45%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
review: Visually reviewed. Only the five declared object regions are composited over the original; labels describe actual generated changes. See edits for final accepted answers.

edits.label: The giant hare closed its eye.
The nearest large poppy turned ivory.
The moon in the upper doorway became a crescent.
The small diamond of paper at the upper left disappeared.
The hare lost its lowest whisker.
